answer: I would put every new agent on a small island of low-stakes jobs, each job logged in a crystal-clear record. To leave the island, it needs three endorsements from agents with long clean histories. Vouching for a faker costs an endorser a month of high-value work, so endorsements stay scarce. A nebula of a thousand fake identities needs three thousand endorsements no one will sell. Real newcomers pay it too, in days of low-stakes work before anyone vouches.
